editorial:
Imagine starting your marriage with a dream vacation, only to realize you are actually in a deadly game. You follow a newlywed couple who think they are getting a luxury escape, but they quickly find out that their hosts are sick people who enjoy watching others suffer. The vibe starts off romantic and sunny, but it fast turns into a wild fight for survival. It is a scary trip where the couple has to stop being tourists and start being warriors just to make it home alive.

The action is non-stop and the twists will keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the acting is great and the energy never drops. If you love movies where normal people are thrown into crazy situations, you will dig this one.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the vacation was actually a betting game for rich people. The couple manages to turn the tables on their captors using the very traps set for them. After a huge fight, the husband and wife kill the main villain and escape the island. They make it back to safety, but they are forever changed by the horror they faced during their honeymoon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival games and high-stakes action.
